axes.origin: the canvas corner that is bottom-left in a top-down view
axes.x: +X is right (east) in a top-down view; the canvas spans 0..canvas.width
axes.y: +Y is up (north) in a top-down view, away from the default front-view camera; the canvas spans 0..canvas.depth
axes.z: +Z is up (Blender world up); the file carries no Z coordinates - everything stands on the ground plane
axes.rotation: degrees counter-clockwise about +Z seen from above, normalized to [0, 360); at 0 an entity's local X (footprint width) runs along world +X and its local Y (footprint depth) along world +Y

anchors.buildings, props, vehicles, people: x, y is the footprint center; the footprint rotates about it
anchors.scatterRegions: x, y is the center of an axis-aligned width x depth rectangle (never rotated)
anchors.base: x, y is the center of an axis-aligned width x depth rectangle (never rotated)

sizes.footprint: final top-down size in meters, footprintScale already applied - never null (a variant with no manifest footprint is resolved to the editor default here)
sizes.footprintScale: the multiplier the editor applied to the variant's footprint; informational - already included in footprint
sizes.height: buildings only: absolute height in meters; NOT multiplied by footprintScale

roads.points: ordered centerline polyline, straight segments only
roads.width: full road width in meters (edge to edge), one value per path
roads.laneWidth: meters; spacing of lane dividers when markings.laneDividers is on
roads.markings: centerLine is a manifest roadStyles.centerLines id or "none"; laneDividers/crosswalk/stopLine are on/off manifest roadStyles.markingFeatures; crosswalk and stopLine sit at the LAST point of the path

junctions.connectionToleranceNote: meters; road points within this distance are the same location
junctions.attachments: one per place a road meets the junction: kind "vertex" = on points[pointIndex]; kind "segment" = partway along segment segmentIndex (points[i] -> points[i+1]); distanceAlongPath = meters from points[0] along the path

scatterRegions.count: exact number of instances to generate (an absolute count, not a density)
scatterRegions.variantIds: manifest asset ids to pick from uniformly at random; an empty list means any manifest asset in the region's category
scatterRegions.instanceFootprint: the largest manifest footprint among the pool; the default below when no pool asset has one
scatterRegions.placement: instance centers uniformly random within the region inset by half the instance footprint on each side, so whole instances stay inside; on an axis where the region is smaller than the footprint, centers sit on the region's center line
scatterRegions.validPlacement: a candidate center is rejected when it falls inside any building/prop/vehicle/person footprint in this file (rotated rect); a vehicles-category center must lie on a road strip (within width/2 of the centerline, including the round end caps); every other category must not
scatterRegions.overlapTest: point-in-footprint: only the instance center is tested, not its own footprint
scatterRegions.instanceOverlap: scattered instances are not tested against each other, within or across regions
scatterRegions.attempts: rejected candidates are redrawn, up to 30 candidates per requested instance in total; a region may yield fewer than count instances (zero for a vehicles region no road reaches into - reported as a scatter-vehicles-no-road warning)
scatterRegions.randomization: regenerated on every import - no seed (FR-18)

conventions.warnings: non-blocking validation warnings at export time (FR-22); message is the editor's text, in editor coordinates - use the structured fields
conventions.previewImage: optional: the filename of a PNG snapshot of the editor view, downloaded as a separate file next to this one (not embedded); absent when no preview was requested
